scientific_integrity: The asserted equivalence is proved by explicit algebraic translation and finite principal-upset decomposition; all computational statements are restricted to enumerated sizes. No formal or third-party certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty preorders only; the infinite-frame analogue is not established. The computer census covers at most three worlds and is not the unrestricted proof. Equivalent older algebraic formulations remain possible.
title: Exact finite-frame correspondence for antecedent disjunction in flat Heyting–Lewis implication
